name: Mediterranean & Middle Eastern
summary: Sage tea, fennel tea, ayran and chicken soup from Greece to the Levant.

remedies.name: Sage Tea
remedies.howItHelps: Greek grandmothers make sage tea with honey for sore throats.
steps: Steep a few sage leaves in hot water.
Add honey and lemon when warm.

remedies.name: Fennel Tea
remedies.howItHelps: Fennel seed tea eases gas bubbles.
steps: Crush a spoon of fennel seeds and steep in hot water.

remedies.name: Ayran / Doogh
remedies.howItHelps: Salted yogurt drink that cools you down in Turkish and Persian summers.
steps: Whisk yogurt with cold water and a pinch of salt.

remedies.name: Grandma's Chicken Soup
remedies.howItHelps: Warm soup keeps you hydrated, and the steam helps a stuffy nose.
steps: Sip warm chicken broth with carrots and celery.

remedies.name: Stewed Prunes & Figs
remedies.howItHelps: Dried plums and figs are packed with soft fiber.
steps: Simmer a few prunes and figs in water.
